notes.title: Alpha Release Ready
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that the Alpha version of our strategy game is now nearly available for testing! This marks a major milestone in our development journey, and we hope to go much further with the support of our community.

What to Expect in the Alpha:

Core mechanics fully implemented, including settlement actions, government types, and unique gameplay dynamics.
Multiplayer functionality to test and refine strategy interactions.
An exciting blend of tactical decision-making and resource management.
Why Your Feedback Matters:
The Alpha phase is your chance to shape the game’s future. Let us know what works, what doesn’t, and what you’d love to see next. Together, we can make this game truly exceptional.

How to Join the Alpha:

Head over to our Steam page to add the game to your wish list to download the Alpha build is available!
Dive into the game, explore its features, and share your thoughts on the forums.
Thank you for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to hear your feedback and see how you conquer the challenges in our world!

See you in the game!
Leon Botha
Leobot Electronics
